name: Days of Memories ~Boku to Kanojo to Koto no Koi~
original_name: Days of Memories 〜僕と彼女と古都の恋〜
source:
The seventh chapter casts you as a member of Iori's band, with younger versions of most of the characters, including Athena, Leona, Kula, and Angel. Whip shows up as a teacher. Also new is Tsunami, who was originally introduced in that Iroha maid game for the mobile phones and DS, as well as a green haired girl named Misato. Kojiroh and Setsuna from Last Blade make an anachronistic appearance, along with Haohmaru, Genjurou, Ash, Kyo, and K'.

[From [url=https://hg101.kontek.net/daysofmemories/daysofmemories.htm]hg101[/url]]
translation:
第七章中，你将扮演伊织乐队的一员，其中包括雅典娜、利昂娜、库拉和安吉尔等大多数角色的年轻版本。鞭子以老师的身份出现。另外还有海啸（Tsunami），她最初是在手机和DS上的《伊吕波女仆》游戏中引入的，还有一个名叫美里（Misato）的绿发女孩。《最后之刃》中的小次郎和刹那以及霸王丸、源十郎、小智、京和K' 的出现不合时宜。

[来自[url=https://hg101.kontek.net/daysofmemories/daysofmemories.htm]hg101[/url]]
